title: Jobber Receptionist Alternatives for Service Businesses
seo_title: Jobber Receptionist Alternatives: Compare Options & Fit
description: Compare Off The Clock AI, Sameday AI, Avoca and Housecall Pro CSR AI as alternatives to Jobber Receptionist—without confusing an add-on with an FSM replacement.
intro: Looking for a Jobber Receptionist alternative without replacing Jobber? Compare Off The Clock AI, Sameday AI, Avoca and Housecall Pro CSR AI. Off The Clock handles answering, supported job pricing and booking; keeping your business software is a separate decision.
verdict: Keep Jobber for managing jobs. Choose Off The Clock for answering, pricing and booking them. QuoteDone combines your own rates with the customer’s job details, alongside business questions, transfers, follow-up and a website quote widget.
reason: Keeping Jobber and keeping Jobber Receptionist are not the same decision. Your records and office processes can remain the system you chose while you select an operator for the price conversation you want handled.

Jobber documents the add-on on select plans at $29 per month for 30 conversations, with $0.79 for an additional conversation; Plus includes unlimited usage. The underlying plan still belongs in a new buyer’s total-cost comparison. [[jobber-help]] [[jobber-pricing]]
choices: Keep your software. Add the pricing conversation.

Off The Clock gives approved flat-rate prices and uses QuoteDone for supported jobs whose scope changes the price. The operator also answers questions, books, transfers and follows up. You are choosing how new inquiries are handled—not signing up to replace your entire job-management system.

Its directory names Jobber. Ask the demonstration to use your required job and booking actions, including repeat customers. An integration logo is a starting point, not a guarantee that all your custom fields and processes transfer.

Consider the extra front-office and coaching scope deliberately. Confirm Jobber compatibility for your proposed setup in writing; a documented integration with another platform is not proof of a Jobber integration.
This is a Housecall Pro decision, not a simple Jobber plugin substitution. Evaluate customer records, office workflows and the base subscription before comparing the CSR AI add-on.

scenario.title: The test: keep the customer record intact
scenario.text: Use a returning customer who has an existing job, asks for additional scope and needs a different appointment. Test with non-production example records so no real schedule or customer is changed.
checks: Does the correct existing customer remain attached to the request?
Can the job and appointment change without a duplicate booking?
Is the price answer a complete project result, a configured service answer or a request for owner review?

questions: Is your current Jobber plan eligible, and what happens after the conversation allowance?
Are call and text conversations counted differently?
Can another operator write the exact fields and actions you need without replacing Jobber?
decision: Keep Jobber for managing jobs. Choose Off The Clock for answering, pricing and booking them. A request for an estimate can still leave you preparing the estimate; QuoteDone is built to handle supported job prices during the inquiry, with your own rates and a website quoting option too. Keep the software you value and change the part of the customer conversation you want off your plate.
faqs: Do I have to replace Jobber to change the receptionist?
No such replacement should be assumed. Assess the operator and the system of record separately, and verify the actual integration before purchasing.
Is the $29 figure the entire Jobber subscription?
No. It is the documented Receptionist add-on on eligible plans; Jobber’s base plan is separate. [[jobber-pricing]]
